market.what: direct air capture (DAC) removal credits contracted per year, world
market.method: 0.841 Mt contracted in 2024 x ~$516/t weighted DAC price = ~$430M; 2025 H1 doubled 2024 H1. Sorbent sales today are far smaller (only 1,186 t delivered by mid-2025)

value.logic: Water co-desorption drives the heat penalty. Est. 1.5 GJ/t less heat x $10/GJ = $15/t, plus sorbent life 2->4 yr at ~$15/kg (~$10/t) = $25/t x est. 5 Mt/yr DAC (~2032) = $125M
value.revenue_logic: sorbent spend est. ~$20/t x 5 Mt = $100M; K14 sorbent/license at 15% share
value.margin_logic: engineered sorbent sold per kg; DAC buyers push price toward $15/kg

trend.drivers: 45Q raised to $180/t for DAC (OBBBA, Jul 2025); Microsoft/Frontier buying; but DOE hub cuts (Oct 2025) and Climeworks 22% layoffs; very uncertain

competition.notes: Climeworks Gen 3 (Svante structured sorbent): half the energy, 2x capacity, 1,300+ cycles. COF-999 (Yaghi/Atoco) 100 cycles in humid air. Top 3 suppliers hold 80% of contracted tonnes.

lab.synth: amine-grafted porous polymer / COF (est.; no early example yet): 10-16 wk class, 2-3 variants
lab.test: CO2 uptake at 400 ppm, 25 C, 20-80% RH by humid TGA/DVS co-adsorption + 100-cycle TVSA; university lab or Surface Measurement Systems service
lab.logic: synth 14 wk + tests 6 wk; $40k sorbent prep + ~$20k humid isotherms and cycling

sale.gates: 1,000+ cycle stability; kg-to-tonne scale-up; 6-12 month pilot module with a DAC developer
